'''West Ryloth Street''' was located within the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. Properties situated on the avenue were held in higher regard compared with those on its counterpart, [[East Ryloth Street]].
